notes.title: The Next Project In Development
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Today I have the pleasure of announcing that the store page for my latest project, [i]Time's Disillusion[/i], is now live. This project will be another step forward for me in learning and improving with my work on different facets of visual novel development, as well as my second attempt at fictional writing as a whole. 

The project has been in development since February 2022, and significant progress has been made. The first draft was completed about a quarter ago, and the script is being revised on a scene-to-scene basis. However, there is still much work to be done, and it is definitely going to be an uphill battle to push through to completion.

Currently, February 2024 is the goal for the release. However, please note that this projection is tentative, and deadlines will be adjusted as needed. 

The game will be available free of charge. More details about the premise can be found on the store page.

Regards,
DeveloperJy
